coverage_legend.native_api: The API has a direct normalized observation or typed command; backend live support may still vary.
coverage_legend.captured_optional: Possible through extensible entity/hero fields or custom adapters, not guaranteed by the shared contract/backend.
coverage_legend.unavailable: Requires a new typed API, host service, event/UI/config integration, or client capability.

gaps: pet health/shield/fuel/activity/position/gears are typed observations (pet feature state) on all backends; pet repair targeting, a server-side stuck timer and ship-specific readiness remain optional
combat fields, inventory, SelectConfiguration and generic UseItem exist; exact attack/event API, NPC flags/config providers and ship-specific cooldown semantics are not universal

ore inventory, balances, cargo and trade-area availability are typed observations (economy state); RefineOre/SellOre are typed commands on all backends, validated against observed inventory and trade-window state
shop/autobuy/backpage purchases still need authenticated host services with completion results; transaction acknowledgements are submission-based, not a typed server result

GUI window/element enumeration, ClickGui/CloseGui and SetOverlay/RemoveOverlay are typed APIs on the Ruffle and Flash backends (packet backend has no UI and fails closed); poll_events is a bounded log/journal stream on all three backends
identifying the specific ad-offer and gate-alert windows is module policy, not new API; captcha support and fast-travel's module-mode/config integration are not exposed

gate spin/place/life purchase typed commands exist on all backends; gate builder progression is a typed observation (gate.builder); SelectGateDifficulty drives the real selection UI on Ruffle and Flash

event schedules/server time and Spaceball team/direction remain captured_optional (spaceball scoreboard widgets, station/event proxies when observable); gate-specific waves/mechanics, browser API state and durable progression are backend-specific or absent

SetOverlay/RemoveOverlay draw host-owned text on the game stage on Ruffle and Flash, and the log event stream is poll_events on all backends; upstream localization parity and the packet backend (no display) remain unavailable

existing GENERAL_BEHAVIORS.md coverage is a constrained port; exact DarkBot providers/config conditions/events and several client/backpage/GUI/profile/group/urgent quest/calendar/economy services are not generally available
rules must fail closed when optional fields/services are missing

shared_plugin_features.notes: UseItem and common health/effects are available; ship capability and exact readiness are optional/backend dependent.

SetPet/SelectPetGear exist; pet feature state exposes owned/active/destroyed/health/shield/fuel/gears/idle on all backends. The specialized pet repair workflow and authoritative completion are missing.
Pet commands exist; pet position, activity/idle and gear state are typed observations where the backend exposes them. A server-side stuck timer still has to be derived client-side.

needs: nearby player/NPC identities, faction, attack state, geometry
shared_plugin_features.notes: Entities, positions and safe places exist; exact enemy/push flags and upstream safety config semantics are optional.
Generic item use exists; specific ship capability/cooldown interpretation can be captured but is not a stable typed contract.

economy.ores/cargo/trade_available are typed observations and SellOre a typed command on all backends (validated against observed inventory and trade area). Trade completion is submission-only and per-material sell prices are not observed.

needs: direct refine capability or GUI transaction
shared_plugin_features.notes: RefineOre is a typed command validated against the observed recipe capacity on all backends. A dedicated transaction-result acknowledgement is still missing.
Generic service registry can host this, but no built-in service/API exists.

Manual attack/follow, named cargo collection and directed travel are implemented. Spaceball team/score widgets are captured_optional observations on the graphical backends; automatic direction policy, event schedule, profile and refresh lifecycle remain unavailable.

needs: NPC waves/IDs and gate-specific combat policy
shared_plugin_features.notes: Existing galaxy family implements typed builder/travel/combat lifecycle; gate.builder progression and SelectGateDifficulty (observed selection UI) are typed APIs on Ruffle/Flash (packet: builder commands only). Broader SharedPlugin gate-specific scripts and event scheduling remain gaps.
Directed portal graph, map traveler and JumpPortal exist; upstream bot module/config context differs.

needs: gate alert visibility and click action
shared_plugin_features.notes: gui.observe plus ClickGui/CloseGui are typed APIs on Ruffle and Flash; identifying the specific alert window is module policy. The packet backend has no GUI.
Enumerated GUI elements expose the offer window when visible; CloseGui/ClickGui act on it on Ruffle and Flash. The packet backend has no GUI.
poll_events is a bounded replay journal on all backends and SetOverlay/RemoveOverlay paint host-owned text on Ruffle and Flash. Upstream localization parity is not implemented.
Rust module identity can supply a local equivalent; upstream runtime class test is not directly portable.

needs: safety policy/config, CBS ownership/hull/ally state, run-mode thresholds
shared_plugin_features.notes: Obstacle geometry, safe places and movement are strong native coverage; policy details and CBS metadata may be optional.
Includes DM/Default behavior ports; exact upstream parity depends on observations and host services, especially profile/backpage/game-log actions.

feature_state_surface: gui element trees with bounds/text/enabled (Ruffle, Flash)
gate builder progression and observed difficulty offerings
event server time/active events/team when observable (Ruffle, Flash)
api_inventory.event_stream: poll_events(after_sequence) returns a bounded ClientEventBatch journal with ordered sequences and dropped-history reporting on all backends (packet journals the decoded stream; graphical backends journal game-log lines).
snapshot_contracts: hero and item data when captured
api_inventory.generic_host_extension: Behavior-engine ServiceRegistry and TaskSequence can add host integrations; currently registered services are not equivalent to upstream GUI/backpage/config/plugin APIs.
known_missing_typed_apis: authenticated shop/autobuy/backpage purchase services with completion results
event schedules/calendar and authoritative per-gate mechanics
hangar switching and profile/config manager operations beyond SelectConfiguration
GUI operations on the packet backend (no display)
pet stuck timer and ship-specific ability readiness
